name: sample-rca
description: Dispatch a coding task to a remote agent running in your own AWS account, and get a pull request back.

api_url.title: Control-plane API URL
api_url.description: Optional override for the control plane's URL. Leave it empty: the server reads the ApiUrl output of the SampleCodingAgentApi stack itself and caches it, which is what makes this install one step with nothing to paste. Setting it exports RCA_API_URL, which **takes precedence over the ~/.rca/endpoint.json endpoint document `make deploy` writes** — so a value left here from an earlier deployment keeps pointing every tool at that older deployment even after a fresh deploy into another region. Set it only to point a second checkout at a second deployment, and read the `endpoint used:` line every tool now prints to confirm which deployment a call reached.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Optional override for the region the deployment lives in. Leave it empty to use the region your AWS credentials already resolve to. Setting it exports RCA_REGION, which pins the region and so takes precedence over the region named in the ~/.rca/endpoint.json endpoint document `make deploy` writes — an unpinned region would otherwise follow that document into whichever region was deployed to last. Set it only if you deploy into more than one region; every tool prints the region it used on its `endpoint used:` line. It is RCA_REGION and not AWS_REGION on purpose: AWS_REGION is left exactly as your shell and Claude Code set it, and is never read as a pin.

stack_name.title: CloudFormation stack name
stack_name.description: Optional override for the CloudFormation stack the endpoint is discovered from. Leave it empty for the default, SampleCodingAgentApi. Setting it exports RCA_STACK_NAME, which also pins the region and so takes precedence over the ~/.rca/endpoint.json endpoint document `make deploy` writes. Set it only if you renamed the stack or run two of them; every tool prints the endpoint and region it used on its `endpoint used:` line.
